Higher Education

What to know about the Cornell University rape allegations

Gov. Kathy Hochul appointed Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor, saying she had lost faith in a county district attorney’s ability to oversee the case.

October 2, 2026 at 2:51 p.m. EDTYesterday at 2:51 p.m. EDT
13 min
Make us preferred on Google
By Amy B Wang
, 
Susan Svrluga
and 
Todd Wallack

Allegations that a Cornell University student was raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 have drawn national attention after the accuser, identified only as “Jane Doe” in court documents, filed a lawsuit last month.
